div.head: Ine 46.1
div.ab: Gif ðonne Englisc onstal ga forð, onsace þonne be twyfealdum; gif hit ðonne bið Wilisc onstal, ne bið se að na ðy mara.
Gif ðonne Englisc onstal gá forð, onsace ðonne be twyfealdum; gif hit þonne biþ Wilisc onstál, ne bið se að :::: mara.
Gyf ðonne Englisc mon stalað, ga forð ætsace be twyfealdum; gyf hit ðonne [biþ Wylisc] onstal, ne bið se að na ðe mare.
Si uero Anglicus in furto prodeat (compellabitur), neget dupliciter; si autem sit Waliscus, non sit iusiurandum eo amplius.
Gif ðonne Englisc onstal ga forð, onsace þonne be twyfealdum; gif hit ðonne bið Wilisc onstal, ne bið se að na ðy mara.
Gif ðonne Englisc onstal ga forð, onsace þonne be twyfealdum. Gif hit ðonne bið Wilisc onstal, ne bið se að na ðy mara.

Wenn jedoch die Klage eines Engländers erscheint, dann reinige sich jener mit doppelt [so starkem Eide]; wenn es aber [bloss] eines Wälschen Klage ist, wird der Reinigungseid nicht um dies [Doppelte] vermehrt.

But if the charge of an Englishman comes forward, then let the accused clear himself with a twice [as strong oath]; but if it is [only] a Welshman’s charge, the oath of exculpation is not increased by this [doubling].

If an Englishman brings the accusation, then he shall deny [the charge] by an oath of double [this] value; on the other hand, if the accusation is brought by a Welshman, the [value of] the oath shall not be increased.
If, however, the accusation is produced by an Englishman, it is to be denied with an oath of double this size; if it then is a Welshman's accusation, the oath is no greater on that account.
If an Englishman pursues the accusation, let him deny it by two-fold [oath]. If, however, a Welshman pursues the accusation, the oath is no greater [than 60].

‘Wenn ein Engländer stiehlt’ verderbt B; ‘in Diebstahl’, on stal trennend, missversteht Q i; er macht, wie B, den Engländer zum Verklagten. — Onstales glossiert invectionis, illationis, und onstælan ‘beschuldigen’ bei Förster in Morsbach Festschr. 163. 170, wie stælan on ‘etwas zur Last legen auf’ Toller. Nicht ‘Ankläger’ oder ‘besondere Prozessart’ ist gemeint. Vgl. Gl Eidesschwere 8; Walliser 5—7, wo man dies ergänze; also gegen Klageeid eines Engländers auf Diebstahl oder Hehlerei fordert Ine Reinigung durch 12 Abendmahlsfähige, noch einmal soviel wie 46³

‘If an Englishman steals’ B, corruptly; Q i, dividing on stal, misunderstands it as ‘in theft’; like B, he makes the Englishman the accused. — Onstales glosses invectionis, illationis, and onstælan means ‘accuse’ in Förster in Morsbach Festschr. 163. 170, like stælan on ‘lay something to the charge of’ in Toller. Neither ‘accuser’ nor ‘a special form of procedure’ is meant. Cf. Gl Eidesschwere 8; Walliser 5—7, where this should be added; thus against an Englishman’s oath of accusation for theft or harbouring, Ine requires purgation by 12 men qualified to receive communion, twice as many as 46³
